translations.web: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.
translations.bsb: Solomon built the inner courtyard with three rows of dressed stone and one row of trimmed cedar beams.
translations.kjv: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
translations.asv: And he built the inner court with three courses of hewn stone, and a course of cedar beams.
